scheme_name: Surgical Grant For The Prevention Of Disability
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Applicant must not be guilty in any criminal case.
Applicant must be a disabled person.
benefits_summary: A maximum of Rs. 6,00,000 may be provided to each disabled person.
documents_required: Certificate of disability granted by a competent medical authority
Certificate of annual income (from all sources)
Estimated expenditure details of the surgery by the superintendent/in charge of the State Hospital
